OpenCC runtime assets
=====================

This folder contains the OpenCC conversion engine, configuration files and
dictionaries used by JianFanConverter at build time. build.ps1 verifies these
files and embeds them into the exe as resources; the app extracts them to a
per-user cache directory at startup, so the shipped exe is self-contained.

Source project: https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC
License:        Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE in this folder)

Engine:
  opencc.dll                                  OpenCC C API native library (Windows x64)

Conversion configs:
  s2t.json / t2s.json                         OpenCC standard (Simplified <-> Traditional)
  s2tw.json / tw2s.json                       Taiwan Standard glyphs
  s2twp.json / tw2sp.json                     Taiwan Standard glyphs + Taiwan phrases
  s2hk.json / hk2s.json                       Hong Kong variant glyphs
  s2hkp.json / hk2sp.json                     Hong Kong variant glyphs + Hong Kong phrases

Dictionaries:
  CJK_Compatibility_Ideographs.ocd2
  STPhrases.ocd2 / STCharacters.ocd2
  STPhrases_GeneratedFromRegionalPhrases.ocd2
  TSPhrases.ocd2 / TSCharacters.ocd2 / TSCharactersExt.ocd2
  TWVariants.ocd2 / TWVariantsPhrases.ocd2 / TWVariantsRev.ocd2 / TWVariantsRevPhrases.ocd2
  TWPhrases.ocd2 / TWPhrasesRev.ocd2
  HKVariants.ocd2 / HKVariantsPhrases.ocd2 / HKVariantsRev.ocd2 / HKVariantsRevPhrases.ocd2
  HKPhrases.ocd2 / HKPhrasesRev.ocd2

Provenance:
  - opencc.dll comes from the OpenCC distribution bundled with ConvertZZ
    v1.0.1.1 (zouhuidong/ConvertZZ, 2025-04-25).
  - The configuration files and dictionaries come from OpenCC 1.4.2
    (BYVoid/OpenCC release "ver.1.4.2", asset opencc-v1.4.2-resources.zip).
  - s2t.json and t2s.json keep the earlier single-segmentation layout because
    the bundled opencc.dll requires a "segmentation" block; the 1.4.2 standard
    configs omit it. Regional configs are used unmodified.

These are OpenCC artifacts and are redistributed here under the Apache License
2.0. No ConvertZZ source code (GPL-3.0) is included in this project.
